marketNotes.text: Tweakers Pricewatch, Azerty, Informatique, Megekko, Dustin.nl (ex-Centralpoint), bol.com, Galaxus, Kaufland, Conrad, PrintAbout and Proshop block scripted access; their offers appear only where Kieskeurig or Beslist listed them, with the comparison URL.
Centralpoint.nl now redirects to Dustin.nl; Dustin.be (Belgium) still serves pages with embedded prices.
ARP.nl (Bechtle group) showed the same prices as Bechtle NL for the SKUs checked, so ARP is not listed as separate datapoints.
Bechtle BE and Bechtle NL price the same SKUs differently (e.g. Quantum MR-L10MQN-01: 408.97 BE vs 336.37 NL incl. VAT).
Aces Direct shows prices excl. VAT only and lists media at roughly double other Dutch sellers.
Tapes.nl shows prices for Symply drives only; HPE and Quantum drives there are quote-only.
No LTO-10 half-height or internal drive with a public price was found in NL/BE; LTO-10 desktop units seen are full-height Symply models.
HPE's newer external drive SKU P84142-B25 is sold as a bundle with 5 LTO-9 cartridges.
LTO-10 40 TB cartridges seen only as Quantum MR-A10MQN-01 at Bechtle NL/BE (not in stock) and a Fujifilm 40TB listing at Galaxus.nl.
Many Bechtle drive prices are for items marked 'Levering zodra beschikbaar' (backorder); some Quantum kit SKUs (-EY) are priced far below the bare drive.
Senetic.nl carries HPE and Dell LTO media and HPE drives; it lists no Fujifilm, IBM or Quantum LTO-6 to LTO-10 cartridges.
Alternate.nl lists a single LTO cartridge (Quantum LTO-9); Alternate.be carries IBM, HPE and Quantum LTO-6 to LTO-9 media but no LTO drives.
DigiNet shows a 5% web discount off suggested retail price, but its structured data marks all LTO media out of stock.
TopTen Storage (Germany) ships LTO drives to NL/BE but quotes German 19% VAT, so it is excluded from this Dutch layer.
New LTO-6 drives appear only as Amazon.nl marketplace offers and one Galaxus.nl listing (via Beslist).
PrintAbout, Proshop, Conrad and 123inkt charge about 4.95 to 5.95 shipping on single cartridges; most other sellers ship free.
